query: Hedy Lamarr "Hollywood composer" George Antheil frequency hopping
notes: Results: sova.si.edu NMAH.AC.1590 and its EAD PDF, prologue.blogs.archives.gov, invention.si.edu (two stories), airandspace.si.edu, si.edu Smithsonian Snapshot, womenshistory.si.edu, two arxiv.org PDFs. Read in browser (403 over http): si.edu Snapshot calls Antheil a kindred inventive spirit known for film scores and says Lamarr codeveloped a patent with him; invention.si.edu 'A Movie Star, Some Player Pianos, and Torpedoes' says they began work on frequency hopping but never calls him a Hollywood composer; womenshistory.si.edu redirected to si.edu/visit. airandspace.si.edu (http) calls him an American avant-garde composer. Existing sources LAM-S-0044 and LAM-S-0045 call him 'a composer she met through MGM Studios' / 'Composer'. No quote states the full claim, in particular 'Hollywood composer', on its own.
